evals.name: story-to-feature
evals.prompt: we're adding a loyalty points scheme to our online shop and I need the cucumber feature file for it. story: as a shopper I want to earn points on my purchases so that I get money off future orders. acceptance criteria: shoppers earn 1 point per whole pound of the order total after discounts are applied; delivery fees never earn points; points are only awarded once the order has shipped, not at payment; an order paid entirely with points earns no points. write the feature file as loyalty-points.feature in the current directory.
evals.expected_output: Well-structured declarative feature file covering every acceptance criterion, one behaviour per scenario, no UI mechanics

evals.name: review-and-rewrite
evals.prompt: our new tester wrote checkout.feature (in the current directory) for our online shop's checkout but it doesn't feel right - review it against gherkin best practice and rewrite it properly. save the improved version over checkout.feature and write review.md listing the problems you found in the original.
evals.expected_output: Rewrite removes UI scripting, splits multi-When journeys, fixes names/independence/missing outcomes; review names the smells
